title: Hotel, Motel, and Resort Desk Clerks
description: Accommodate hotel, motel, and resort patrons by registering and assigning rooms to guests, issuing room keys or cards, transmitting and receiving messages, keeping records of occupied rooms and guests' accounts, making and confirming reservations, and presenting statements to and collecting payments from departing guests.

projection.title: Hotel, motel, and resort desk clerks

tasks.text: Make and confirm reservations.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Booking travel and reservations via tools

dwas.name: Make travel, accommodations, or entertainment arrangements for others.

tasks.text: Greet, register, and assign rooms to guests of hotels or motels.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Physical presence greeting customers

tasks.text: Verify customers' credit, and establish how the customer will pay for the accommodation.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Transactional data verification is rule-based and reliable

dwas.name: Verify accuracy of financial or transactional data.

tasks.text: Post charges, such as those for rooms, food, liquor, or telephone calls, to ledgers, manually or by using computers.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Maintain financial records; human reconciles exceptions

tasks.text: Issue room keys and escort instructions to bellhops.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physically distributing materials to people

dwas.name: Distribute materials to employees or customers.

tasks.text: Advise housekeeping staff when rooms have been vacated and are ready for cleaning.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Providing routine information to coworkers is text-based

dwas.name: Provide information to coworkers.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Transmit and receive messages, using telephones or telephone switchboards.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Operating comms hardware needs hands-on setup and tuning

tasks.text: Record guest comments or complaints, referring customers to managers as necessary.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Maintain financial records; human reconciles exceptions

tasks.text: Keep records of room availability and guests' accounts, manually or using computers.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Maintain financial records; human reconciles exceptions

tasks.text: Perform bookkeeping activities, such as balancing accounts and conducting nightly audits.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Maintain financial records; human reconciles exceptions

tasks.text: Compute bills, collect payments, and make change for guests.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Cost calculation from structured inputs

dwas.name: Calculate costs of goods or services.
Execute sales or other financial transactions.

tasks.text: Review accounts and charges with guests during the check out process.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Account discussions need human relationship and judgment

dwas.name: Discuss account status or activity with customers or patrons.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with People Outside the Organization

tasks.text: Contact housekeeping or maintenance staff when guests report problems.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Reporting maintenance problems is routine messaging

dwas.name: Report maintenance or equipment problems to appropriate personnel.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Clean and maintain lobby and common areas, such as restocking supplies and watering plants.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical cleaning of facilities and equipment

tasks.text: Date-stamp, sort, and rack incoming mail and messages.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Sorting physical mail requires hands-on handling

tasks.text: Answer inquiries pertaining to hotel services, guest registration, and travel directions, or make recommendations regarding shopping, dining, or entertainment.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Customer dialogue needs live presence and adaptation

dwas.name: Discuss goods or services information with customers or patrons.
dwas.gwa_name: Interpreting the Meaning of Information for Others

tasks.text: Deposit guests' valuables in hotel safes or safe-deposit boxes.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physically placing and storing items

tasks.text: Prepare for basic food service, such as setting up continental breakfast or coffee and tea supplies.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Plating food is fine manual dexterity

tasks.text: Plan, schedule or supervise the work of other employees.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Draft schedules; human owns fairness and coverage

dwas.name: Prepare employee work schedules.
dwas.gwa_name: Coordinating the Work and Activities of Others

tasks.text: Arrange tours, taxis, or restaurant reservations for customers.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Booking travel and reservations via tools

dwas.name: Make travel, accommodations, or entertainment arrangements for others.
